title: Those who came
goal: Use -(y)An participles as nouns, with plural and case endings: gelenler, geç kalanları, Türkçe bilen biri.

intro.text: Drop the noun and the participle becomes one: *gelenler* (those who came), *geç kalanları* (the latecomers, as an object), *kazanan* (the winner). With *biri* and *kimse*: *Türkçe bilen biri* (someone who knows Turkish).

vocab.en: all of them, all of it

exercises.question: *Yarışmayı Elif kazandı. Kazananı tanıyor musun?* What is *kazananı*?

why.1: There's no prize in the sentence. *Kazanan* is the one who won.
why.2: `-(y)An` takes its time from the sentence, and Elif has already won.

exercises.explain: *kazan-an* (the one who won) + *-ı* (accusative): **do you know the winner?**

exercises.en: All the people who came to the party were my friends.

reject.why: *Hepsi* (all of them) needs its owner in the genitive: *gelenlerin hepsi*.

exercises.explain: *gel-en-ler-in hepsi*: all of those who came. *Hepsi* takes a singular verb: *arkadaşımdı*.

exercises.prompt: Is there anyone here who speaks Turkish?
accept: Burada Türkçe konuşan biri var mı?
Burada Türkçe bilen biri var mı?
We did not wait for the latecomers.
We did not wait for [the people|those|the ones] who were late.
We did not wait for [the people|those|the ones] who came late.

exercises.gloss: those who came, as an object (… gördüm)
exercises.explain: *gel-en* (the one who came), *-ler* (plural), *-i* (accusative): a participle takes noun endings once its noun is gone.

exercises.en: All the people taking part in the competition are very young.

exercises.text: Those who come early can sit down.
accept: Those who come early can sit.
Those who came early can sit down.
Those who came early can sit.

exercises.en: There's a present for the winner of the competition.

reject.why: **For the winner**: the gift goes to someone, so the dative: *kazanana*.

exercises.explain: *kazan-an* (the one who wins) + *-a* (dative): **to the winner**. *Kazananlara* is **to the winners**.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **Nobody here speaks Turkish**?
exercises.explain: *Konuşan kimse yok*: **there is nobody who speaks**, with *kimse* and *yok* as in A1.

exercises.prompt: I am looking for someone who knows German.

reject.why: *Biri* is a pronoun, and a pronoun object takes the accusative: *birini arıyorum*.
